cells.positiveCue: Stay with one local continuation and leave it unfinished.
Let an observation turn slightly without explaining the turn.
Keep one unresolved pressure alive at the end.
Let a concrete relation between two things carry the paragraph without adding a story.
Use unequal sentence weights and do not smooth them into symmetry.
Let the paragraph stop rather than conclude.
Follow plain sequence without balancing two sides.
Allow the cadence to change when the thought changes pace.
